# ClipExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Clip layers by a rectangular bounds.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/clip-extension",
  "type": "ClipExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/clip-extension').par.clipByInstance` (an input) and `op('/clip-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.clipByInstance`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `clipByInstance` | `BooleanField` | `false` |
| `clipBounds` | `UnknownField` | `[0,0,1,1]` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs
